mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met but followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met but followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 on 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
